item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Tropical Cyclone Yagi is expected to move towards the vicinity of the northern part of Luzon today and tomorrow. It will then have a higher chance to enter the northern part of the South China Sea and further develop, and edge closer to the vicinity of the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. However, there is still a chance that Yagi will move towards the vicinity of Taiwan and the East China Sea after crossing Luzon. Under its influence, the weather will become unsettled gradually over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be windy with swells.
